--- title: "[PoolExecutor]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} A `concurrent.futures.Executor` over a pymizu pool. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/shikokuchuo/pymizu/blob/main/python/pymizu/_executor.py#L46-L241){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python PoolExecutor( pool, *, stop_pool=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} `submit()` returns a real `concurrent.futures.Future`: `wait` / `as_completed` / `result(timeout)` / `asyncio.wrap_future` and the stdlib base `Executor.map` all work unchanged, so code written against `ProcessPoolExecutor` drops in. `create()` spawns an owned pool instead. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [pool]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [pymizu.Pool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The pool to wrap; its lifetime stays with its owner unless `stop_pool` is set — then `shutdown()` stops it. [stop_pool]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : When True, `shutdown()` stops the wrapped pool. ::: ## Notes {.doc-notes} Deltas from stdlib semantics: a task's failure surfaces as `pymizu.TaskError` (the remote error envelope); `Future.running()` is always False (futures resolve at completion); cancellation is advisory, mirroring [`Task.cancel()`](`pymizu.Task`) — and `shutdown(cancel_futures=True)` cancels every outstanding future, since the pool exposes no queued-versus-running signal (a running task completes, but its result is discarded). `map` is the stdlib base implementation over `submit` — for bulk maps, `Pool.map` is the faster path. ## Examples {.doc-examples} Use as a drop-in `concurrent.futures.Executor`: ::: {#a4d882b1 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pymizu with pymizu.PoolExecutor.create(2) as ex: futures = [ex.submit(pow, 2, i) for i in range(4)] results = [f.result() for f in futures] results ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [1, 2, 4, 8] ``` ::: ::: ## Methods {.doc-methods}
Name Description
create() Spawn an owned pool —
shutdown() Stdlib shutdown.
submit() Schedule `fn(*args, **kwargs)` on the pool.
### [create()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Spawn an owned pool — ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/shikokuchuo/pymizu/blob/main/python/pymizu/_executor.py#L98-L117){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python create( workers=1, **pool_kwargs, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} [`Pool.create()`](`pymizu.Pool.create`) with `workers` and `pool_kwargs` — and wrap it; `shutdown()` stops it. ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [workers]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Number of worker processes for the pool. [pool_kwargs]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [\_Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [{}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Forwarded to [`Pool.create()`](`pymizu.Pool.create`). ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ A PoolExecutor wrapping the spawned pool.]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : ::: ### [shutdown()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Stdlib shutdown. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/shikokuchuo/pymizu/blob/main/python/pymizu/_executor.py#L161-L183){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python shutdown( wait=True, *, cancel_futures=False, ) ``` ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [wait]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Wait for the outstanding futures. [cancel_futures]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Cancel the not-yet-started futures. Stops the pool only when `stop_pool` was set. ::: ### [submit()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Schedule `fn(*args, **kwargs)` on the pool. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/shikokuchuo/pymizu/blob/main/python/pymizu/_executor.py#L119-L159){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python submit( fn, /, *args, **kwargs, ) ``` ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [fn]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [\_Callable[..., \_Any]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The callable to run. [args]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [\_Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [()]{.doc-parameter-default} : Positional arguments for `fn`. [kwargs]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [\_Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [{}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Keyword arguments for `fn`. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ A `concurrent.futures.Future` resolving with the result.]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : ::: #### Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [RuntimeError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : After shutdown. :::
